requirements.general_text: Any one of these: Bachelor’s Degree – (Level 6, KKM) in the related field, with at least CGPA 2.75 or equivalent as approved by the PPT Senate Bachelor’s Degree – (Level 6, KKM) in the related field, with CGPA 2.50 but not achieving CGPA 2.75 can be admitted, subject to rigorous internal assessment process Bachelor’s Degree – (Level 6, KKM) in relevant field but did not achieve CGPA 2.50, can be admitted subject to min 5 years working experience in the appropriate field and rigorous internal assessment. English Proficiency Requirements: TOEFL 500 or  IELTS 5.0
